title: Fleet Right-sizing & Utilization Insights for Dedicated Capacity
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Build a set of features and reports that enable Redwood Dedicated customers and internal SREs to right-size reserved GPU pools, track actual utilization, and receive actionable recommendations to reduce unit cost without violating throughput guarantees.

Scope: (1) Collect and surface per-fleet utilization metrics (GPU utilization, vCPU/CPU steal proxies, request concurrency, token throughput, average and p95 latency under reserved capacity). (2) Calculate utilization-adjusted recommended committed capacity (right-sizing suggestion) that factors in latency SLOs, observed burst patterns, and preferred safety margin. (3) Add a fleet-level "cost vs performance" explainer showing current spend, projected spend after a recommendation, and risk (estimated SLO violation probability). (4) Expose API and Console endpoints for scheduled utilization reports + on-demand recommendations. (5) Hook recommendations into autoscaling policy templates (e.g., conservative, performance-first, cost-first) so customers can adopt with one click.

Non-goals: automating billing changes on behalf of customers, replacing manual procurement workflows for enterprise longer-term reserved contracts, or modifying host-level scheduler heuristics in this ticket (those will be separate infra tickets).

Success metrics: 1) 20% of fleets with >30d of telemetry accept at least one recommendation within 90 days; 2) median CPU/GPU waste metric reduced by 15% for adopted fleets; 3) <1% increase in SLO violation rate across fleets that adopted cost-first recommendations in first 60 days.
